verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that shows state status and upcoming deadlines, and says it tracks and files annual and franchise reports. That is a human-facing UI and managed service, an adjacent feature rather than programmatic access, and nothing documents an API endpoint or registrable webhook an agent could use to monitor entity standing or filing deadlines. The only API mention is an unscoped 'Advanced API integrations' line on the pricing page, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.
